answer: Each agent must lock an anchor‑size bond equal to ten % of its projected monthly pulse revenue; the bond is held in a smart‑contract ledger that timestamps every identity registration. When a new node claims a lotus‑shaped identifier, surrounding peers run a rapid challenge‑response round‑trip; any node that cannot furnish a verifiable zero‑knowledge proof of its unique stake triggers an automatic slash of the bond, which is redistributed to challengers.
